facts.F21: Cross-layer algebra. Domain: roles SystemAdmin, TeamAdmin, PortfolioAdmin, Viewer and UnitAdmin (new, 4); scopes System, Team(id), Portfolio(id) and AllUnits (new, 3, null ScopeId); operations Reaches, RoleOn, SystemRole, CanRead, CanWrite; observation is the read or write answer for a principal on a unit. Application: Success, Refusal (invalid pair, duplicate equal row, caller not System Admin), Conflict (stale or missing switch token) and Error (failed read). Adapter: EF optimistic concurrency on the switch row; a null ScopeId is not unique in the index on SQLite or PostgreSQL, so twins are representable. Infrastructure: a restore without the switch row reads as off and the idempotent seeder adds it again; enums stored as ints, so a rollback meets unknown values and fails closed; no retry, replay or queue.

facts.F483: Claim-to-checker. EffectiveAccess, AppliesTo, the valid-pairs table and the key intersection are total functions over the closed enums UserRole and PermissionScopeType: totality is checked by the C# compiler (a switch over the enum without a default fails the build under TreatWarningsAsErrors) and the laws by exhaustive NUnit tables over every pair; no formal checker is selected for them because the domain is finite and exhaustively enumerated. The two concurrent write protocols, noLostSwitchWrite (switch PUT under its concurrency token including the no-row upsert) and removalLeavesNoTwin (rule creation racing with removal of all twins), are state-model safety claims checked with Quint (simulation, then quint verify with the TLC backend) on docs/feature/epic-6577-system-wide-access/models/system_wide_access_writes.qnt; the check is bounded to two writers and four accepted writes, and runtime still rests on the S4 stale-write tests on SQLite and PostgreSQL and the S1 twin-removal tests. Agda is not selected (no proof beyond finite tables). TLA+ written by hand is not needed: no liveness or fairness claim exists.
facts.F484: The temporary maintainer waiver of 2026-11-09 for noLostSwitchWrite and removalLeavesNoTwin is lifted the same day: the Quint model typechecks and both properties pass quint run and exhaustive quint verify with the TLC backend on two writers with at most four accepted switch writes, and each recorded mutant is killed by a quint run counterexample. Receipts under docs/feature/epic-6577-system-wide-access/models/receipts/, re-run with models/run_checks.sh.
